changes: Stealth alerts use altered versions of the game's stealth sound: lower when enemies enter stealth and higher when they leave it.
Stealth alerts now also work in active battlegrounds and arenas. Existing sound settings, muted enemies and alert priorities still apply.
On Cata, alerts follow combat-log events. Retail and Forever use readable enemy casts and reappearance.
notice: Restart WoW after updating; new addon files cannot be loaded with /reload alone. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
